summary.text: Mother of the twin Moliones Cteatus (`cteatus-epeian`) and Eurytus (`eurytus-epeian`) by Actor (`actor-epeian`) — the Epeian house whom Nestor almost slew before Poseidon shrouded them in mist, though Homer calls them only 'of the blood of Actor' in the Catalogue.

story.text: Homer remembers the Moliones twice over: as striplings who donned battle-gear when the Epeians marched against sandy Pylos, and as the twin captains' sires' line whom Nestor almost cut down in the plain until the wide-ruling Shaker of Earth saved them in thick mist.

Apollodorus makes Cteatus and Eurytus twin sons of Actor by Molione — two men joined in one, unmatched in strength — whom Augeas appointed generals when Heracles marched against Elis. In the same account their sire is sometimes named Poseidon rather than Actor.
